from.place: Proof paragraph 2, middle derived mapping-complex comparison before the inverse limit: Infinity-categorical monadicity and the augmented counit bar resolution. Supporting foundation: Free coherent monad modules and their augmented free resolution. Supporting lemma: Coherent two-sided bar from a bimodule and a left module. Operadic Segal encoding of composable bimodules, before forming or realizing any bar.

title: Operadic Segal encoding of a composable pair of bimodules
statement:
Use the universe, quasicategory, nerve, coherent-functor and mapping-space conventions of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the inert maps and Segal/mapping-space product decompositions of [def-coef-monoidal-infinity-category]. A nonsymmetric infinity operad means an inner fibration over $N(\Delta^{\mathrm{op}})$ with cocartesian lifts of inert maps and those two product decompositions; arbitrary base maps need not have cocartesian lifts. Here $\Delta$ has objects $[r]=\{0,\ldots,r\}$ and monotone maps. An algebra in an infinity operad $\mathcal X^\otimes$ for a planar coloured operad $\mathsf O$ means an inert-preserving coherent functor $N(\mathsf O^\otimes)\to\mathcal X^\otimes$ over $N(\Delta^{\mathrm{op}})$, with all coherent transformations over that base.

Define the ordinary planar coloured operad $\mathsf{Chain}_2$ with colours $a_0,a_1,a_2,p,q$. Its operation sets are singletons exactly for the ordered input/output types
$$a_i^r\to a_i\ (i=0,1,2),\qquad a_0^r p a_1^s\to p,\qquad a_1^r q a_2^s\to q\quad(r,s\geq0),$$
and are empty otherwise. Composition substitutes ordered input lists; $a_i^0$ is the empty list and unary identity operations are included. For such an operad, $\mathsf O^\otimes$ has objects finite ordered lists of colours. A morphism from a length-$n$ list $(c_1,\ldots,c_n)$ to a length-$m$ list $(d_1,\ldots,d_m)$ over the opposite of $f:[m]\to[n]$ is a choice, for every $1\leq j\leq m$, of an operation $(c_{f(j-1)+1},\ldots,c_{f(j)})\to d_j$. Inputs before $f(0)+1$ or after $f(m)$ are discarded. Composition substitutes these operations. Inert maps select a consecutive sublist by unary identity operations.

Let $\mathsf{BM}_{01}$ and $\mathsf{BM}_{12}$ be the full suboperads on $\{a_0,p,a_1\}$ and $\{a_1,q,a_2\}$, and let $\mathsf{Ass}_1$ be their common one-colour suboperad on $a_1$. For every nonsymmetric infinity operad $\mathcal X^\otimes$, restriction induces an equivalence of infinity-categories
$$\operatorname{Alg}_{\mathsf{Chain}_2}(\mathcal X)\simeq\operatorname{Alg}_{\mathsf{BM}_{01}}(\mathcal X)\mathbin{\times}_{\operatorname{Alg}_{\mathsf{Ass}_1}(\mathcal X)}\operatorname{Alg}_{\mathsf{BM}_{12}}(\mathcal X),$$
where the fiber product is the infinity-categorical pullback and includes the specified coherent identification of the shared algebra. This equivalence is natural in $\mathcal X^\otimes$. In particular, for a map of infinity operads $v:\mathcal X^\otimes\to\mathcal O^\otimes$ and a fixed $g:N(\mathsf{Chain}_2^\otimes)\to\mathcal O^\otimes$, restriction also gives the corresponding equivalence of categories of algebra lifts over $g$. These relative categories are the infinity-categorical fibers of postcomposition over $g$ (so include the coherent identification of the base map); when the induced postcomposition functor on algebra categories is a categorical fibration, its strict fiber is an equivalent model. Neither presentability nor existence or preservation of colimits in the target is assumed.

source.place: Higher Algebra (2017), Proposition 4.4.1.11 (Segal condition), printed p. 560; Remark 4.4.2.2, printed p. 574, and the relative formulation used in Construction 4.4.2.7. The displayed planar category is the nonsymmetric ordered-word model of Tens_[2]. Online source read; WANTED: archived Higher Algebra. No Stacks tag treats this operadic infinity-categorical encoding. The planar presentation uses Definition 4.4.1.1 (colours (i,i) and (i,i+1)) and the planar/associative comparison of Theorem 4.1.3.14 and Proposition 4.4.1.17; its block operations are the consecutive intervals selected by Cut.
